query: For a 68-year-old female I am evaluating: among female inpatients age 63–73 transferred from another hospital, report LOS mean and SD (days) stratified by discharged home, hospice, or in-hospital death.
final_sql: SELECT p.discharge_location, p.deathtime, AVG(a.los) AS average_los, STDDEV(a.los) AS standard_deviation_los FROM patients p JOIN admissions a ON p.subject_id = a.subject_id JOIN transfers t ON a.subject_id = t.subject_id WHERE p.gender = 'F' AND p.anchor_age = 68 AND p.anchor_year_group BETWEEN 63 AND 73 AND t.eventtype IN ('A', 'H', 'D') GROUP BY p.discharge_location, p.deathtime ORDER BY p.discharge_location, p.deathtime NULLS LAST;
